convention: World Z-up metres, ground z=0, origin on the ground under camera s26, +Y = s26 forward projected on ground. R,t are world->camera (OpenCV: x right, y down, z forward): x_cam = R@X + t. Pixel (plate 1280x536): x=xc/zc, y=yc/zc, r2=x*x+y*y, u=f*x*(1+k1*r2)+cx, v=f*y*(1+k1*r2)+cy. C = camera centre. blender_matrix_world = camera object matrix_world (Blender -Z forward, +Y up). Blender: sensor_fit HORIZONTAL, sensor_width 36, lens_mm. frame = s index 0-51 = Blender scene frame; plate_file = edit/v001/plate numbering (s+1). Projection is only valid for r2 < 1.0 (frame corner r2 = 0.64): beyond r = 1/sqrt(-3*k1) = 1.30 the polynomial folds back, so clip 3D lines/points with r2 >= 1 (or behind the camera) before projecting. Pixel coords: (0,0) = top-left CORNER of the image, first pixel centre = (0.5,0.5) (COLMAP = canvas convention).
